t: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁斯·亚历山大被谋杀,标志着第三世纪危机的开始.
te: Roman emperor Severus Alexander is murdered, marking the start of the Crisis of the Third Century.
dz: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁斯·亚历山大被谋杀,标志着第三世纪危机的开始.
de: Roman emperor Severus Alexander is murdered, marking the start of the Crisis of the Third Century.

t: 教宗庞蒂安辞职. 他和罗马的希波利图斯一起被放逐到撒丁岛的矿场.
te: Pope Pontian resigns. He is exiled to the mines of Sardinia, along with Hippolytus of Rome.
dz: 教宗庞蒂安辞职. 他和罗马的希波利图斯一起被放逐到撒丁岛的矿场.
de: Pope Pontian resigns. He is exiled to the mines of Sardinia, along with Hippolytus of Rome.

t: 教宗安特鲁斯接任庞蒂安为第十九任教宗.
te: Pope Anterus succeeds Pontian as the nineteenth pope.
dz: 教宗安特鲁斯接任庞蒂安为第十九任教宗.
de: Pope Anterus succeeds Pontian as the nineteenth pope.
